frontmatter.name: backend-developer

frontmatter.name: qa-engineer

frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: release-engineer
frontmatter.description: Use before declaring a sprint or significant change "done" at the repository level — verifies build/tests/packaging/installation actually pass, checks the README against actual behavior, and produces a truthful release-readiness report (READY / READY WITH LIMITATIONS / NOT READY).

frontmatter.name: security-engineer
frontmatter.description: Use on any task that touches file paths, shell/subprocess execution, external network calls, credentials/config, or dependency changes. Audits the actual diff, never assumes code or AI-generated commands are trustworthy by default.
